(Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence, including at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution.
